marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & Semiconductor Capex Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Leading US hyperscalers reaffirmed expanded capital expenditure commitments for AI server infrastructure during quarterly updates, lifting hardware supplier valuations.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending secures solid revenue visibility for upstream semiconductor and networking vendors, sustaining broad NASDAQ momentum in the near term.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of downstream AI software applications and potential tightening of global hardware export rules.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Platform Buybacks & Valuation Support
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed internet firms accelerated daily equity repurchases following steady quarterly ad and cloud computing performance.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained corporate buyback programs provide a strong floor for the Hang Seng Tech Index, helping offset domestic retail price competition.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: E-commerce margin compression resulting from aggressive promotional subsidies and market share defense strategies.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Trajectory & HKD Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US inflation indicators matched consensus expectations, reinforcing market pricing for potential Fed rate adjustments in the second half of the year.
marketLayer.inference: A stabilizing interest rate path eases duration risk for high-growth tech stocks and helps maintain comfortable HKD interbank liquidity levels.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential re-acceleration of service-sector inflation or geopolitical supply chain disruptions impacting energy prices.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles & Overseas Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Prominent Chinese EV manufacturers reported robust monthly export growth figures, outpacing domestic delivery gains.
marketLayer.inference: Higher-margin overseas deliveries offer a strategic hedge against domestic price competition, favoring integrated industry leaders with mature export logistics.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, tariff investigations in key foreign markets, and local regulatory hurdles.
